people.name: Baruch
people.line: Jeremiah's scribe who recorded and delivered his prophecies.

people.name: Micaiah
people.line: Son of Gemariah, reported Baruch's reading of Jeremiah's scroll.

translations.web: Then Micaiah declared to them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.
translations.bsb: And Micaiah reported to them all the words he had heard Baruch read from the scroll in the hearing of the people.
translations.kjv: Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.
translations.asv: Then Micaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.
